summary: Opens a Miles audio filter by index (0-3): resolves the filter name string for the index via sub_404FA0, enumerates available Miles filters with AIL_enumerate_filters until the name matches, and, when the config pointer this+0x54 is set, opens the matched filter with AIL_open_filter (provider handle at config+0xE4) and stores the index, filter handle, and provider parameter into this+0x60/0x64/0x68.

operations.description: Require a2 < 4 (valid filter index 0-3); otherwise return 0 without acting.
Look up the filter name string for index a2 via sub_404FA0 (callee 0x00404FA0); abort when the name is null.
Enumerate Miles filters with AIL_enumerate_filters (global 0x0059E3B0), strcmp-looping until a name match or enumeration end.
Require the enumeration to have produced a valid filter handle (a2 != -1) before opening.
When this[0x54] (config pointer) is set, open the matched filter via AIL_open_filter (global 0x0059E3B4) using the provider handle stored at config+0xE4.
Store the original index a2 in this[0x60], the matched Miles filter handle in this[0x64], and the provider parameter a3 in this[0x68].
